initialBuild.description:
## Savvy_Basics

*Far Sight helps your Crit Rate + Crit Damage. Past 100% Crit Rate, Crit Damage = Active Damage.
*Level Lucky Clover to squeeze out more Drop Rate and EXP.
*Level Idle Casting based on how often you're AFK vs Active on ES.
*Putting a point into STR, AGI, and Max HP talents allows them to be affected by any +LV talents. May be worth it with enough added Talent levels.

## Mage

*Chaotic Force will sometimes shoot a Fireball, so at least 1 Point.
*Choppin It Up EZ gives damage based on your Chopping minigame highscore. After your other talents are leveled, this should your focus.
*You can put 1 point in Free Meal if you have plenty of excess points. Ignore completely otherwise.

## Wizard

*Speedy Book will increase in duration, eventually becoming semi-permanent. Low priority.
*You can use a Reset Potion after leveling Fuscia Flasks to save Points.
*Nearby Outlet after all important talents are booked and maxed.
*Earlier Education as needed. At least 1 point for +LV.

## Elemental_Sorcerer

*At least one point in Symbols of Beyond (SoB), then only level it in multiples of 20.
*Note that Dimensional Wormhole spawns come in Waves, each Wave having more HP. You will reach a point where you can't kill any more mobs. Increase your damage to reach further Waves of enemies.

*Leveling Chaotic Force to a decent activation chance will greatly improve your area damage output.
*Meteor Shower and Lighting Barrage will be your main damage dealers.
*Wormhole Emperor is multiplicative, but takes awhile to get going. Level it when able, but you won't get much use from it initially.
*ONLY level Gods Chosen Children when you have God Rank, until then it's useless.
